The first release of **Fusebox**: one fast binary that turns your Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Antigravity, Grok, Kimi, Meta, Devin and Vertex accounts into OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini compatible APIs, with a dashboard built in.

Fusebox grew out of [CLIProxyAPI-Rust](https://github.com/IuCC123/CLIProxyAPI-Rust) by [@IuCC123](https://github.com/IuCC123) and carries on from its v0.3.2. Everything you set up for CLIProxyAPI-Rust or CLIProxyAPI keeps working.

![Fusebox dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DigitalPals/Fusebox/main/assets/screenshots/overview.png)

## Highlights since v0.3.2

- **Usage and costs.** A Usage page records the tokens every request used, can import opted-in Claude Code and Codex histories (also from a collector on another machine), and estimates what that would cost at API list prices. Named clients give each tool its own key, so you can see which tool sent what.
- **Smart quota balancing.** `routing: smart-quota` sends new sessions to the account whose weekly limit renews first, so allowance that would expire unused gets used, while a 5-hour reserve protects sessions that are already running.
- **Better prompt caching.** Conversations without a session id are recognised by their first message and stay on one account, and ChatGPT, OpenAI and xAI get a stable cache key.
- **A rebuilt dashboard.** New design, a command palette (Cmd/Ctrl K), a phone layout, a Models page, live account activity, a settings editor alongside the YAML file, and setup snippets for Claude Code, Codex, the OpenAI SDK and curl under Config, Clients.
- **Installable app with push notifications.** Over HTTPS the dashboard installs as an app and can notify you when a sign-in expires or a provider runs out of capacity.
- **New models without a release.** Claude and Codex accounts fetch their model lists from the provider, and the Models page can add any other model by hand.
- **Current client identities.** Requests match Claude Code 2.1.296, Codex CLI 0.162.1, Grok Build 1.0.50, Muse Code 1.4.4, Devin CLI 3000.11.3 and Antigravity 2.22.0, and a daily check opens an issue when one of them falls behind.
- **Banked resets** (opt-in): see and use the limit resets your Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions have banked.
- **Management API:** `GET /api/faults`, a faults event on `/api/live`, and ongoing sessions in load events.
- **Fixes:** token accounting when a client closes a finished stream, adaptive thinking across Claude tool turns, idle Codex WebSockets (thanks [@dr-baker](https://github.com/dr-baker)), compressed request bodies, and faster streaming with per-account connection pools.

## Install

Download the archive for your platform below, extract it and run `./fusebox`. Then open http://127.0.0.1:8317 and connect an account.

| Platform | Archive |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `fusebox-…-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| macOS, Intel | `fusebox-…-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| Linux, x86_64 | `fusebox-…-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| Linux, ARM64 | `fusebox-…-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| Windows, x86_64 | `fusebox-…-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |

`SHA256SUMS` lists every archive's checksum, and each archive has a build attestation you can check with `gh attestation verify <archive> -R DigitalPals/Fusebox`.

Or run the `ghcr.io/digitalpals/fusebox` image (amd64 and arm64) as the [quick start](https://github.com/DigitalPals/Fusebox#quick-start) shows, or build it with Rust 1.88 or newer: `cargo install --git https://github.com/DigitalPals/Fusebox`.

The binaries are not code-signed. If macOS refuses to open it, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine fusebox` once.

## Upgrading from CLIProxyAPI-Rust

- The binary is now `fusebox` and the image `ghcr.io/digitalpals/fusebox`.
- `auth-dir` defaults to `~/.fusebox`, but `~/.cli-proxy-api` is used when only that one exists.
- The `CLIPROXYAPI_RUST_*` variables and `x-cliproxy-*` request headers still work. The response header naming the account is now `x-fusebox-account` (was `x-cliproxyapi-rust-account`).

See the [README](https://github.com/DigitalPals/Fusebox#readme) for configuration, endpoints and coming from CLIProxyAPI.
